live.claim: A kept uncommon enemy drop visibly retains its authored source and gives an explicit later return journey.
live.baseline: The staged rare Hat of Too Many Committees showed Hostile Paperwork, Kettlewick and Lunch Hearing provenance while the world map showed a gold ORIGIN ECHO: Nib-7 marker.
live.action: Opened Equipment, read the provenance card, then opened World Map.
live.observed: The card named the gold marker, Nib-7's Duplicate Stamp Garden, zero cost and zero item consumption. The marker title named Kettlewick and the exact installation.

live.claim: The return site is a physical persistent installation and settlement changes the saved world without pressure currency.
live.surface: in-app browser / Kettlewick Duplicate Stamp Garden / 1280x720
live.baseline: A gold-ringed stamp installation was visible on open Kettlewick ground with SETTLE DUPLICATE STAMP GARDEN WITH NIB-7 and 20 bolts.
live.action: Activated the single E interaction once.
live.observed: The action changed to REVISIT DUPLICATE STAMP GARDEN, the HUD still showed 20 bolts, and the visible result stated Hostile forms travel 25% slower, FREE, PERMANENT and ITEM NOT CONSUMED.

live.claim: The authored world consequence outlives the equipment and an ordinary canonical-route reload.
live.baseline: The resolved inventory card stated that the world change remains after salvage.
live.action: Manually salvaged the staged rare item, navigated to /games/014/ without the QA query, and continued the saved world.
live.observed: The item stayed absent, bolts rose from 20 to the advertised 27, the physical installation remained, and the action remained REVISIT with persistent world change and no item required.

limitations: visual.capture.ephemeral-rolling-buffer/v1 was unavailable, so no sub-frame projectile-speed or attack-telegraph timing claim is made.
Nib-7's paperwork installation was exercised live; the other four distinct effects, duplicate suppression, auto-salvage exclusion and save normalization are deterministic and package evidence.

visualReceipt.nextCheapestTest: When rolling capture exists, compare Hostile Paperwork projectile travel over a fixed distance before and after settlement.
